Outlaw Rogue Rotation in 

Outlaw Rogue is a fairly simple spec once you get past the high APM requirements. The 3 key factors of the spec. Using your cooldowns on cooldown, making sure to efficiently spend combo points without overcapping, and maintaining high APM and not missing a potential global. The core concepts to keep in mind in single target are these, in order of importance:

 

 

 
 Cooldowns On Cooldown: Oultaw Rogue has a handful of minor cooldowns that you want to make sure to use on cooldown. These primary cooldowns are Blade Rush , Adrenaline Rush , and Between the Eyes . 
 

 

 
 

 
 Reacting to Procs While Keeping Pace: Outlaw Rogue is a spec you need to maintain a high rate of actions per minute (APM), while also reacting to the 2 primary procs the spec has. Opportunity being an enhanced generator, and Ace Up Your Sleeve causing you to generate combo points after you cast Between the Eyes . 
 

 

 
 
 
 Managing Resources: Combo Points are the main resource we play with; avoid overcapping them as much as possible.

Pre-Combat Check

 Before any combat happens, it is important for Outlaw Rogue to make sure the following are done. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.

 Apply Weapon Poisons 
 

 Outlaw Rogue Major Cooldowns

Unlike a majority of specs in WoW, Outlaw Rogue doesn't really have a "major cooldown" in the traditional sense, instead trading that off for a mediocre cooldown that has an above-average uptime. Below, I will highlight some of the more important cooldowns we have either way.

 
 Adrenaline Rush 

 While this buff is active, we gain a dramatic increase to our energy regen and a lowered GCD that scales with haste. It can be decreased to 0.8 seconds from the base 1 second with 25% haste. We only need 22% raw due to Alacrity . With Restless Blades being as strong as it is, good play directly links to more uptime of Adrenaline Rush . 

 
 Roll the Bones 

 How it works is that whenever you press the button, you are given a random stage of the 4 possible outcomes. Each stage gives you a bonus alongside all the previous stages. 

 Stage 1 is increased Opportunity chance.
 Stage 2 is Sinister Strike generates an additional combo point.
 Stage 3 is increased Restless Blades effectiveness.
 Stage 4 is increased Critical Strike chance.

 
 Keep it Rolling 

 Despite this spell's massive 6-minute cooldown, its effective in-combat cooldown is only around 1:15 seconds thanks to Restless Blades . To avoid wasting its cooldown, you will want to use this any time Roll the Bones is on stage 2 or higher.

 
 Preparation 

 This ability, in most instances, can be fairly autopilot, just use it when the conditions are met. However, because this doesn't work with Restless Blades , we can be a bit more nuanced in its usage on certain encounters. If a fight is, for example, only going to last 3 minutes, you always get 1 cast of Preparation . This means we can use the spell at the best of an encounter, which could be a burn phase, or even an add phase to maximize AoE damage. Keep in mind that you don't want to lose casts by holding it for too long!
